parameters.query: WITH win AS (SELECT $1::timestamptz AS ws, $2::timestamptz AS we) SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM raw_messages WHERE posted_at BETWEEN (SELECT ws FROM win) AND (SELECT we FROM win)) AS raw_msgs, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM signals WHERE posted_at BETWEEN (SELECT ws FROM win) AND (SELECT we FROM win)) AS signals_captured, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM signals_market_context smc JOIN signals s ON s.id = smc.signal_id WHERE s.posted_at BETWEEN (SELECT ws FROM win) AND (SELECT we FROM win) AND smc.price_at_capture IS NOT NULL) AS signals_priced, (SELECT ROUND(AVG(smc.slippage_pct)::numeric, 2) FROM signals_market_context smc JOIN signals s ON s.id = smc.signal_id WHERE s.posted_at BETWEEN (SELECT ws FROM win) AND (SELECT we FROM win) AND smc.slippage_pct IS NOT NULL) AS avg_slippage_pct, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM llm_usage WHERE error IS NOT NULL AND error <> '') AS llm_errors_total, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM llm_usage WHERE error IS NOT NULL AND error <> '' AND called_at BETWEEN (SELECT ws FROM win) AND (SELECT we FROM win)) AS llm_errors_window, (SELECT updated_at FROM fyers_token WHERE id=1) AS fyers_token_updated, (SELECT MAX(posted_at) FROM signals) AS last_signal_at;
